plugins.name: sd-core
plugins.description: Holds no code. Installs secret-guard, the one mod every computer must have.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Stops a prompt that looks like it contains a secret, before it is sent.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Your plan's 5-hour and 7-day usage above the prompt, with the reset countdown and the session's cost.

plugins.name: agent-radar
plugins.description: One live line above the prompt per running subagent or background shell. /radar shows the details.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds a risky shell command and shows what it would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons.

plugins.name: voice-fix
plugins.description: Swaps misheard words in a prompt using your own glossary. No model call.
